CAMERA. Compose 9:16 with the action in the safe centre band. Use a handheld follow with visible micro-shake and breathing correction on a 14mm ultra-wide, framing with a stacked layered composition with three depth planes.

OUTPUT. Return ONE image-generation prompt as a single unbroken paragraph. No preamble, no headings, no bullet points, no commentary, no markdown.
